labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3 part 2), test video: scoring only
rule: as for the dev clip: event frame = first frame whose centre (960, 540) shows the other side of the surface; crossing = frames in between. Exits here pass through a phase where the dome is half out of the water: a sharp circular waterline rim appears and the centre sits in a brownish band (water film / grazing view of the surface) below the sky; crossing_first = first frame with that rim, event = first frame with sky at the centre. Entries: crossing = whitish surface foam over the lens; event = first frame with dark water (with bubbles) at the centre.
